name: Zombville General
description: Zombville General Hospital, the last stop in the city, seen from its upper floor: the old brick wing (surgery, pre-op and recovery, the cafeteria, the morgue, the chapel) and the new tower (the ICU, patient rooms, radiology, the lab, the pharmacy, the ER), joined by a glass atrium with its fountain and a skybridge over the courtyard below. Backup power, rooms sealed off, the dead everywhere. The military is evacuating from the roof.
